home.title: Software that takes you places.
home.kicker: Where are you trying to go?
home.description: Bring us an idea, a slow process, or something that's just not working — you don't need to know the technical fix.
home.messyDescription: You don't need to know the solution before talking to us. You just need to know something's not quite right.

Our customers keep calling us about this.

messyQuotes.text: I have an idea, but I don't know if it's possible.

home.perspectiveHeading: You know your business. We bring a different perspective.
perspectiveBody: You know your customers, your industry, your workflows, and the history behind why things are the way they are. We bring curiosity, problem-solving experience, and the technical skill to build.
Neither of us just hands the other a list. The interesting opportunities show up somewhere in the conversation — usually when someone asks, "wait, if we had that, couldn't we also…?"
home.processImageAlt: Listen, Imagine, Build, Learn, Improve — real progress isn't a straight line, so Improve feeds back into Listen and the cycle starts again.
home.situationsDescription: Start with what's actually going on, not what you think you need.

services.title: How we help
services.description: You probably don't know if you need a website, an integration, or a custom system — and that's fine. Start with what's actually going on. We'll figure out the rest with you.

situations.title: I have an idea.
situations.detail: Maybe you're not sure it's possible, or worth doing yet. Tell us about it and we'll help you figure out what it would actually take.

situations.title: This takes way too much time.
situations.detail: Show us how you're doing it now, step by step. Sometimes the fix is small. Sometimes it opens up something bigger.

situations.title: Our current system isn't working anymore.
situations.detail: Before we talk about replacing anything, we want to understand what it's actually doing, and why it stopped working.

flowdek.title: FlowDek
flowdek.description: One embedded system for estimates, scheduling, notifications, rewards, and reviews. It fits into the workflow your business already uses, not the other way around.
flowdek.modulesDescription: Six modules that work together or independently. Use only what your business needs.

modules.title: Smart Estimate Generation
modules.description: Generates accurate estimates automatically from job details, pricing rules, and historical data.

modules.title: Quote Generation
modules.description: Turns estimates into polished quotes your customers can approve in a click, before the lead goes cold or calls the next contractor.

modules.title: Appointment Scheduling
modules.description: Lets customers book against your real availability, synced with your calendar. Less phone tag, fewer surprises for the crew.

modules.title: Notifications
modules.description: Automated reminders and updates by SMS and email, so customers and crews stay in sync without someone playing dispatcher all day.

modules.title: Rewards & Referrals
modules.description: Referral tracking and reward incentives that turn happy customers into new business.

modules.title: Reviews
modules.description: Automated review requests timed to the moment customers are happiest with the result.

whyItems.title: Lives in your product
whyItems.description: No separate login or app. FlowDek runs inside the software your customers already use, so adoption is not another job to manage.

whyItems.title: Built by developers, for developers
whyItems.description: Clean APIs and documentation for agencies and dev teams. When a client says it is a small change, you will be ready.

whyItems.title: Modular by design
whyItems.description: Adopt one module or all six. Every piece is independently configurable.

about.title: About Nomadicode
about.description: Nomadicode started with a simple idea: software should take you somewhere. Not toward more software — toward a better way of working, a new opportunity, or something that wasn't possible before.
about.notJustTitle: We're not just engineers you hire.
notJustBody: Most software companies wait for a spec. We'd rather sit down with you, hear about the business, and ask a lot of questions — some of them not obviously related to whatever you first asked about.
That's usually where the more interesting work comes from. We walk into something messy or unfamiliar, get genuinely knowledgeable about it, and look for what's possible once we understand it.
whoWeAreBody: Nomadicode is a team based in Utah and Colombia. Two places, one way of working: curious, hands-on, and genuinely invested in the problem in front of us.

Working across two countries has shaped how we think, not just where we sit. It's given us range — different backgrounds, different experiences, a habit of asking questions rather than assuming we already know the answer.
wontDoBody: We won't manufacture a problem to make a sale. If your current system works, we'll tell you. If a $30 product solves it better than anything we'd build, we'll point you to it.
The goal is to make something better. Sometimes that means building software. Sometimes it doesn't.
technicalBody: Underneath the conversation, there's a full engineering team: web and mobile applications, integrations, automation, custom backend systems, and applied AI where it genuinely helps. We work across modern frameworks and can meet an existing codebase wherever it is.
about.technicalNotePrefix: If you want to go deeper on the technical side of a specific project, the case studies on
about.technicalNoteSuffix: include notes for the technically curious.

contact.title: Let's talk about your business.
body: No pitch. No homework. You don't need to know what you need.
Bring us an idea, a problem, something repetitive, or something you think could work better. We'll talk it through, ask questions, and tell you what we see.

sections.heading: Who we are and what this policy covers
body: Nomadicode LLC is a Utah single member limited liability company. This policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, retain, and protect information connected with the Nomadicode website and inquiries submitted through it.
For privacy questions or requests, contact us at hello@nomadicode.com.

sections.heading: Information you provide
body: When you use our contact form, we collect your name, email address, and the message or project details you choose to provide. Please do not include passwords, payment card data, government identification numbers, health information, or other sensitive information in a contact form submission.
We use this information to respond to your inquiry, evaluate a potential engagement, communicate with you, maintain business records, and protect our services from misuse.

sections.heading: Google Analytics and cookies
body: When Google Analytics is enabled on the site, it uses cookies and similar identifiers to measure site traffic and usage. This may include pages viewed, interactions, referring pages, browser and device information, approximate location derived from IP address, and pseudonymous identifiers. We use this information to understand how the site performs and improve it.

Google Analytics commonly uses first party cookies such as _ga and _ga_<container-id>. We do not send names, email addresses, contact form messages, or other information that directly identifies you to Google Analytics. We will configure analytics to honor consent choices where consent is required by applicable law.

You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings and can use the Google Analytics opt out browser add on. For more information about how Google handles information from sites that use its services, visit https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.

sections.heading: How we share information
body: We do not sell contact form information. We share information only as needed to operate the site, respond to you, comply with law, protect rights and safety, or complete a business transaction such as a merger or asset sale.

Our service providers may include Supabase for contact message storage, Brevo for contact notification email, Google Analytics when enabled, and hosting or infrastructure providers. They may process information only as needed to provide their services to us and under their applicable terms and safeguards.

sections.heading: Retention and security
body: We retain contact submissions for as long as reasonably necessary to respond, maintain business records, resolve disputes, and meet legal obligations. Analytics retention is controlled through the settings of the applicable Google Analytics property.
We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect information. No system is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: Your choices and privacy rights
body: Depending on where you live and subject to applicable law, you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, or to object to or restrict certain processing. To make a request, email hello@nomadicode.com with enough information for us to verify and respond to your request.

You may decline nonessential cookies through available consent controls where presented, or manage cookies in your browser. We will not discriminate against you for exercising applicable privacy rights.

sections.heading: International processing, children, and links
body: Our service providers may process information in the United States or other countries. Those countries may have privacy laws that differ from the laws where you live.

The site is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. The site may link to third party websites or products. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy when our practices, technology, or legal requirements change. We will post the revised policy here and update the effective date.
